verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs describe Alerts for monitoring error rates and costs on LLM requests. Each alert can be configured with filters and notifies through Slack or email, and alerts are listed as a feature on a paid pricing tier. That covers the core of the story: error-rate and cost alerts delivered to Slack or email. Missing for 10: alerts on eval-score drops, PagerDuty as a notification channel, detail on how cost-spike thresholds are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting.
